tests.name: loaded Core matches frozen v35 recovery provenance
CFG construction rewrites shared branch operand to a Block
shallow list copy preserves shared mutable Instruction instances
branch rewrite resolves original normal-return instruction identity
handler-shaped instructions physically exist before pruning
entry-only instruction enumeration omits handler-shaped instructions
normal reachability pruning removes all handler-shaped blocks
branch clone maps targets to cloned identity before CFG construction
cloned CFG rewrites only the cloned branch
all original fixture instructions remain unmodified by cloned CFG
duplicate identity rejects before temporary CFG construction
outside branch target rejects without mutating source

scope: Actual existing Core CFG construction and pruning on original synthetic ISIL only. Handler-shaped blocks have no EH descriptor in current Core and are omitted/pruned by normal reachability. A shallow list copy shares mutable instructions; a branch-remapped fixture clone preserves the source. No general mutable-operand clone, SSA exception semantics, native unwinding or CIL EH emission is tested.
